title: JSON Resource not emitting the changed signal when modified in internal editor
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 13 Mar 2025 15:20:33 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Vega 11 Graphics (radeonsi, raven, ACO, DRM 3.61, 6.12.19-1-lts) - AMD Ryzen 5 2400G with Radeon Vega Graphics (8 threads)

### Issue description

JSON Resource not emitting the changed signal when modified with the embedded JSON Editor.


### Steps to reproduce

I'm attaching a minimal reproduction project to help further.

- select the test scene main node
- drag test.json into the Json Property
- double click on test.json, the editor opens
- modify the json and save
- the console doesn't say nothing (it should say "Json Changed!")

Extra bug:
- close test.json on the internal editor
- open test.json with an external editor and save it
- go back in godot
- NOW the console says "Json Changed!"
- double click again on test.json
- the embedded editor opens up blank, with "Unknown Error Getting Token"


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_json_changed.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19576038/test_json_changed.zip)
